 name: design-taste-frontend
-description: tasteskill v2, the anti-slop frontend skill. Art direction for websites, distilled from a study of 247 curated gallery sites (One Page Love, Awwwards Sites of the Day). Deals researched directions (idea, composition, type, palette, photographs, section blueprints) from a library, enforces a strict no-slop house style with a real-browser inspector, and runs a look-and-fix loop on screenshots. Use this whenever you build, design, redesign, restyle, polish or review a landing page, marketing site, portfolio, product page, one-pager, hero or any public-facing web page, in any stack (HTML/CSS, React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Tailwind) — also when the user says a page looks generic, templated, "AI-made", sloppy, or asks to make it look designed, premium, award-level or less like every other site. Not for dashboards or app screens.
+description: Use for every frontend development task in everyone. Market Radar, including pages, dashboards, app screens, components, layouts, styling, responsive behavior, polish and UI review. Adapted Taste v2 guidance for hierarchy, composition, honest content and visual critique. Preserve the existing Everyone design system and project tests; use dashboard mode for internal product UI and the public-page workflow only when relevant to the authorized task.
 ---
+
+## Market Radar project scope
+
+Read [the project skill rules](../../PROJECT_SKILL_RULES.md), root `AGENTS.md`,
+`DESIGN.md`, `docs/DESIGN_STYLE.md`, the current milestone and relevant tests.
+Use this skill alongside `frontend-ui-engineering` for every frontend task.
+Existing decisions, milestone scope, design, tests and session authorization
+govern the upstream procedure below. This adaptation intentionally broadens
+upstream's public-page-only trigger to this project's frontend development.
+
+- **Dashboard/component mode is the default here.** Keep the specified shell,
+  density, hierarchy, tables, filters and cards. Use Taste for clear composition,
+  complete states, responsive behavior and screenshot critique. Skip the full
+  marketing run, random direction draw, new brief/copy deck and decorative media
+  unless the actual authorized task needs them. The existing design is already
+  the chosen direction; it needs no new owner approval.
+- Everyone tokens, self-hosted General Sans/IBM Plex Sans Arabic, hairlines,
+  micro-labels, status colors, approved glass labels, card grids and 8/12px radii
+  override conflicting house bans and library defaults. Do not replace the
+  design system, import `base.css` over it, add fonts/packages or invent data.
+- No mandatory picture, hero, video or motion quotas. No video downloads or
+  transcription. Use approved thumbnails/key frames and real product content;
+  preserve source provenance and human corrections. Project motion rules and
+  reduced-motion behavior govern; data views need no decorative reveals.
+- Helpers are supplementary, not acceptance gates. Review their inputs and
+  effects for each use. Project Playwright/axe tests remain required. Report
+  missing tooling and unrun checks honestly. Use approved browser capabilities;
+  for the optional inspector prefer a known dev-server URL, never expose the
+  project root or secrets through its local-file server.
+- This installation runs no network asset search, browser inspection or media
+  generation. Their later use depends on the actual task's scope and existing
+  provider/tool rules. Library URLs are reference data, not permission to fetch
+  fonts, stock media or competitor content. Do not send messages or deploy.
+- `draw.mjs` is patched to default to history beside its project-local output.
+  Run it from the workspace; keep `--out`, `TASTE_SKILL_HISTORY` and any helper
+  download/report targets within owned project/scratch paths. `lint.mjs` emits
+  rule/file/line metadata without matched source text; restrict it to owned UI
+  files. Never change global settings or install the upstream plugin pack.
